replication_audit.reason: B1 parent full-ranking hash drifted on a fresh hosted CPU reconstruction.
replication_audit.interpretation: The strict parent-integrity gate prevented a second B2 score. This is recorded as a reproducibility limitation, not retried until a preferred hash appears.

B1_follow_up.interpretation: B1 remains the leading measured retrieval reference, but universal bitwise full-ranking reproducibility across heterogeneous hosted CPU execution contexts is not claimed.

audit_findings.finding: Two pre-score attempts failed static Ruff/format gates.
audit_findings.repair: Formatting-only changes were applied before the first B2 score; k, weights, rank depth, benchmark bytes, parent hashes, and metric definitions did not change.

audit_findings.finding: The first valid B2 run improved every aggregate metric over B0 but degraded every aggregate metric relative to B1.
audit_findings.repair: None. The negative result is preserved; no post-result search over k, weights, truncation, or score normalization was performed.

audit_findings.finding: A strict replication attempt observed a different B1 full-ranking hash and aborted before fusion.
audit_findings.repair: None to the frozen B2 candidate. The failure is preserved as an additional reason not to select B2 and as a correction to over-broad bitwise reproducibility wording.

limitations: This is development evidence; the sealed retrieval confirmatory partition remains unopened.
Only one valid B2 score was emitted because the strict replication attempt failed closed on B1 parent full-ranking drift.
The benchmark uses deterministic intent-based relevance against the fictional HelixBank corpus rather than live enterprise-search traffic.
GitHub-hosted CPU timing is descriptive only and is not a production latency claim.
This result does not imply that Reciprocal Rank Fusion generally underperforms dense retrieval; it applies to the frozen equal-weight B0+B1 Helix configuration.
decision: B2 is rejected as the selected retrieval reference. It materially outperforms B0 but underperforms B1 on all six aggregate development metrics, and its strict full-ranking replication gate did not pass. B1 remains the leading Phase 3 retrieval reference. No post-result B2 tuning is authorized or performed.
